newsitem.title: USA: Videoserver sees Q2 loss of $0.60-$0.67/shr.
newsitem.headline: Videoserver sees Q2 loss of $0.60-$0.67/shr.

text.p: VideoServer Inc said Monday it expects to report a net loss of about $8-$9 million or $0.60-$0.67 per share in the second quarter on revenues of about $11 million.

The company said the loss would include a pre-tax charge of about $14 million for purchased research and development related to the acquisition of the network access card business unit of Promptus Communications.
Without the charge, the company said it would have been "modestly profitable" for the second quarter.
It said it expects to release final results for the quarter on July 10.
In the second quarter of 1996, VideoServer reported a net income of $2.243 million or $0.17 per share, on net revenues of $11.27 million.
